subject: Lightning POC results and a quick advocacy ask
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearcart.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC wrap up — initial numbers attached

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks again for the fast turnaround on the POC. We wrapped up our internal validation this morning and wanted to share a short results snapshot. The attached "clearcart_poc_results_summary.pdf" has the full table, but the headline numbers:

- 22% reduction in average search latency for autocomplete queries (p95 down from 480ms to 375ms)
- 14% increase in add-to-cart conversion on the tested cohort (A/B, 30k users)
- Estimated inference cost per 1k queries down ~18% after batching/quantization tweaks

These are preliminary but directionally solid — engineering is happy with latency and ops is pleased with the cost delta. We’re comfortable with Redwood being listed as a vendor in our partner directory and would be open to a short quote.

Attaching the PDF and a latency chart. If you need a short on-record quote, I can send one-line approval today. Otherwise, happy to jump on a 15-minute call tomorrow.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Product, ClearCart

Attachments: clearcart_poc_results_summary.pdf (PDF); latency_chart.png (PNG)

Hi Oliver — fantastic, thanks for sharing these numbers and the PDF. Quick ask from our side: would ClearCart be open to either

1) A 1–2 sentence quote about impact we can include in a short case snippet (we’ll share copy before publishing), or
2) A 15-minute recorded checkbox call (we capture a 20–30s soundbite + one screenshot + permission to use the ClearCart logo)

Either is totally fine — we often put the one-liner next to the headline metrics in a short customer note. If you’re happy to approve a line now, we can draft optionally; otherwise we can book a quick call.

If yes to the call, does 10:30–10:45 PT tomorrow work for you? If not, send over a 1–2 sentence line and we’ll sign off.

Thanks again — big win.

— Hannah
